data.title: Order to stop residential use of garden house
data.summary: The City of Musterhagen's building supervision authority has prohibited living in the garden house at Zechenweg 3. Residential use must end by 30 November 2027, or a coercive fine of €1,500 becomes due.
data.explanation: The city found during an inspection that the garden house is lived in permanently without a building permit. It orders you to stop this use completely by 30 November 2027. If you don't, a coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €1,500 becomes due. You may file a court action (Klage) at the administrative court; there is no objection procedure (Widerspruch). The app shows the deadline for the action. Consider getting legal advice from a lawyer or tenant/housing adviser soon, especially if someone lives in the house.

items.title: End residential use of garden house
items.action: Stop using the garden house as a residence completely by this date.
items.consequence: A coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €1,500 becomes due.

date.text: Die Wohnnutzung ist bis zum 30.11.2027 vollständig aufzugeben.

items.quote: Die Wohnnutzung ist bis zum 30.11.2027 vollständig aufzugeben.

items.title: Deadline to file court action (Klage)
items.action: If you want to challenge the order, file a court action at the administrative court in writing or on record at the court registry.
items.consequence: The order becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
